sin.name: derived-collection-cast
sin.description: A `#[DataCollectionOf]` is filled by mapping a factory over inputs at the call site, where a `#[WithCast]` should own the derivation
sin.rule: Move an element derivation (`array_map(E::for(...), $xs)`) into a `#[WithCast]` / `IterableItemCast` on the collection property; pass the raw list.
sin.suggestion: `#[WithCast(SomeCast::class)] public array $items` — the cast runs `E::for(...)` per item; the call site passes the raw values.
